about: Value investing through an insurance group. Canada-based.

checks.msg: 22% of the latest portfolio couldn't be matched to a ticker, so it is shown by filed name only.
2 holding(s) left out of the copy record because the ticker's price didn't match the price filed (often an old ticker now used by another company): CRESY, MIDD.

summary: Concentrated: 32 holdings, but the top ten are 91% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 63% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 2.6 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are less profitable and slower-growing.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 2 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1950 in Hyderabad, India; IIT Madras and the Ivey Business School. In 1985 took over a small Canadian insurer and renamed it Fairfax Financial Holdings. Often called the 'Canadian Warren Buffett'.
profile.approach: Value investing of an insurance group's money, sometimes with large hedges against market falls.
known: Agreed in 2013 to a $4.7 billion offer to buy BlackBerry (it did not go ahead).
profile.note: This is Fairfax's portfolio; much of it is in bonds and non-US companies, which the 13F does not show.

name: Prem Watsa
